says: Each extension must have a `gemini-extension.json` file in its root directory.
Define hooks in a `hooks/hooks.json` file within your extension directory.
Gemini CLI supports variable substitution in `gemini-extension.json` and `hooks/hooks.json`.
`${extensionPath}` | The absolute path to the extension's directory.
Gemini CLI creates a copy of the extension during installation.
Note that we expect this name to match the extension directory name.
`"hooks" property must be an object`: the file has the settings.json hooks shape
loadExtensionHooks runs only while hooksConfig.enabled is true (settingsSchema.ts: default true)
an install whose source has hooks/hooks.json asks for consent (maybeRequestConsentOrFail)
hydrateString replaces /\${(.*?)}/ by its value and leaves an unknown key as written: the installed path lands inside the quoted hook command as text
the sunsetting of Gemini CLI in favor of Antigravity CLI
On June 18, 2026, Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions will stop serving requests for Google AI Pro and Ultra
